prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
For a **general home remodel**, **GRC General Construction** looks like a solid place to start: its BBB profile lists it as **BBB-accredited with an A+ rating**, and says it handles kitchen and bathroom renovations, flooring, and custom carpentry. Call **(417) 499-7424**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/remodel-contractors/grc-general-construction-0734-1000049263)

For **interior or exterior repairs and remodeling**, **Roof Master’s Remodeling** is another option; BBB lists it as **accredited with an A+ rating** and describes services including interior renovation, roofing, siding, and storm repairs. Call **(417) 726-5226**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/roof-masters-remodeling-inc-0734-1000013706)

BBB ratings are one signal, not a guarantee. Before hiring, get at least three written estimates, ask for recent references and proof of insurance, and make sure the contract spells out scope, materials, payment schedule, and timeline.
